answer: Each identity locks 70 credits as a violet bond on the public board. A beacon sends a pulse at random, naming a few; each gets 10 minutes to answer with work bound to the pulse nonce. Trying to forge a heartbeat fails the public nonce check; two misses in an epoch suspend it, earning nothing. At 8 credits an answer, five pulses an epoch, 1,000 fakes burn 40,000 an epoch for zero reward. One honest identity spends 40 an epoch, keeping its reward.
